customer: Caller, a college student leasing a convertible in North Carolina, rambled a bit about wanting to get out of the lease before graduation and asked whether she'd get any money back if Northwind's offer comes in higher than her buyout, mentioning her lease is through Bluewater Leasing.
agent: Customer asked what happens if our offer exceeds her lease buyout amount; explained per 'If our offer is more than your lease buyout' that the difference is lease equity and who receives it depends on the leasing company. Advised that since her lease is with Bluewater Leasing, the equity would be applied to a car she buys from Northwind rather than paid to her directly. Also noted that if our offer is lower than the buyout, she would pay the difference at the appointment, the same as negative equity.
